author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Introduction:
As many of you know, the rotations changed a lot with the introduction of Atlas. I think the Map Developers have done an excellent job of revamping the rotations to remove maps that were unfit, and adding new maps. I would like to state my thoughts on a few things that, in my opinion, could be improved.

1. General
  • I think one of the side goals of the update was to create an environment in which many different gamemodes are played. For this reason, I do not understand why there are two Destroy servers. All of the maps on Destroy1 and Destroy2 should be combined onto a single server, which might be called Destroy.
  • The rotations on all servers should be significantly longer. Generally, all servers have rotations that consist of 8 to 13 maps, with Deathmatch being the shortest rotation at 5 maps. I do not understand why the rotations are so short, since one of the issues is that Avicus feels the exact same a lot of the time. Adding longer rotations would help a great amount with diversity in gameplay, and I am sure that there are enough maps to do so. [If there was a shortage of Destroy maps, they would not have been marked as not needed by the map developers months ago.] If there are not enough Capture or Deathmatch maps, this should be clearly stated, and maps submitted for this gamemode should be fast-tracked in the map acceptance process.
  • There are gamemodes that a significant amount of maps were submitted for, that are simply not anywhere in the rotations, such as 3CP/5CP and KoTH. Even if there are not enough maps for these gamemodes to warrant their own server, they should certainly be added to the Mix server, where there are currently none.
2. Server-Specific

Destroy: 
1. There should not be two of the same map in the rotation, as is seen with Rendezvous and Rendezvous Redux. Out of the two, Rendezvous Redux is much less of an eyesore and is better in other ways, so it should be kept while the original should be removed. The only value it has is nostalgic value, and Avicus needs to move foward instead of living in the past. Atlas is all about moving foward.

2. Many of the maps in the rotation are from the days before Atlas was removed. There are a decent amount of maps that were submitted relatively recently, and barely any make their appearance in the rotation. One example that comes to mind is Tasty Fight.

Capture:
1. I know I have already mentioned the point relating to not enough maps in the rotations, but I would like to reiterate it just because of how prominent it is on this server. There are 5 CTW maps and 3 CTF maps on this server. That is barely any. Part of the reason that Capture is not played too often is that it is often just the same gameplay over and over again, and this extremely low amount of maps in the rotation does not help that at all.

2. This is a smaller issue, but if more maps are added, there should be a more or less even spread of CTF throughout the rotation, instead of being all one after another as they currently are.

Deathmatch:
1. FFA maps should be added to Deathmatch. This would help lengthen the barely-existent rotation of only 5 maps, and would provide another place for the FFA maps to be played other than Mix.

Mix:
1. Since it is a Mixed rotation, players on this server generally are not looking for a single gamemode. So, there should not be instances of two maps with the same gamemode immediately after one another.

2. More gamemodes such as KoTH, 3CP, and 5CP should be added to this server, since they do not have their own server and thus have no other place.

Epilogue:
I think the Map Developers have done a great job at revamping the rotations, and they are much better than the previous ones that existed when Avicore was being used. These are my personal opinions on what should be improved. If you have opinions on this matter, you may state them as well.

Thank you for reading.
